ctx.x: And the Commandateur of Paris, his name was General Von Stulpnagel. He was the Commander of Paris. The Parisian regent. And he came up, and with all his staff officers and everything, and they were very surprised, 'cause I was about the only inkspot on the stand. (Laughter). And they were very surprised because that party, they believed that everything that was not Caucasian, of the Caucasian race, was a monkey or something else, you see. (Laughter).
